page.layout: Two columns side by side. Left column: running text, a series of short annal entries, each set apart by space. Right column: lists of names in italic, grouped by rules, with a year numeral in the right margin beside each group. A small note in the right column beside the Gerdt Lewe group. Printed page number at the top.

main_text.p: Albertus Saxo in Frisia venit & homagium recipit. Cū Groninganis colloquia instituit. Groningani Dammonā praesidio Edsardi munitam per Vlricum Dorn. tentant.
Albertus è Misnia reversus cum exercitu, filio obsidione Franck liberato, Groningam obsidet. Bellum pactione dirimitur studio Georgii Thorenii & Frid. episcopi Vltr. Albertus discedens Emdae moritur.
Edsardus Dammonam à Groninganis obsessa & oppugnatam cum clade eorundem obsidione liberat.
Res ad inducias rursum studio Vltraiectini inter civitatem & Saxones ac Edsardi perductae.
Induciis prorogatis saepius, variis colloquiis tentata compositio.
Compositio tentata per Philippum Austriacum Burgundiae ducem.
Groninga armis Saxonici: d.ce EDSARDO obsessa,& in angustias reda:ta[?].

p.note: Ex his unum in consulatu obiisse exististimo.

page.notes: Printed page number "34" at the top. Right column: each group of names is set off by a printed rule; the years 1499 to 1505 stand in the right margin beside the groups. The small text "Ex his unum in consulatu obiisse exististimo." is set in the right column beside the Gerdt Lewe group, with a hyphen at the line end ("exististi-mo"); it is written here as a note. Several words in the left column are uncertain: "reda:ta" and "Saxonici:" are copied as printed with the colon. The top right corner has handwritten marks, which are not transcribed. Handwritten strokes near the name lists are also not transcribed. Some names are faint, especially "Hindrick Reberch", "Garmet Allema", and "Johan Tedem", and may contain errors in the letters.
